spec2def(hotplug.dll hotplug.spec)

file(GLOB hotplug_rc_deps resources/*.*)
add_rc_deps(hotplug.rc ${hotplug_rc_deps})

# hotplug.dll is all Rust (hotplug-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/hotplug-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# hotplug.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/hotplug-rust/src/hotplug/hotplug.rs)
# eject.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/hotplug-rust/src/hotplug/eject.rs)
# enum.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/hotplug-rust/src/hotplug/enum.rs)
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(hotplug_res OBJECT hotplug.rc)
target_compile_definitions(hotplug_res PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_include_directories(hotplug_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
set(HOTPLUG_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/crt/CMakeFiles/oldnames.dir/oldnames.a)
add_cargo_module(hotplug hotplug-cargo hotplug.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE hotplug-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS hotplug_res ${HOTPLUG_REUSED})
